comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic media from retained washers through a screen; pr-1151 purges air from a syringe while preserving liquid and returns it to a rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual load sharing, controlled sieve agitation, selective aperture passage, and reseating; pr-1151 tests syringe reorientation, barrel stabilization, precise plunger advancement, and fluid-loss control. Shared careful handling and re-racking are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered media mass, complete washer retention, support seating, 60 mm release, and a 3 s dwell with spill/damage gates; pr-1151 grades residual air and sample loss plus syringe pose, release, and a 1 s hold. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: The tested transformation—many-body size separation through physical apertures—is meaningfully different from controlled air expulsion through a syringe.
